requirement: This code should implement a triple-axis homing routine for CNC machines using the provided inputs and outputs. It should handle the homing process for X, Y, and Z axes based on the execution signal `bExecute`. Each axis has a reference switch (`bAxisXRefSwitch`, `bAxisYRefSwitch`, `bAxisZRefSwitch`) and uses parameters for slow and fast velocities (`fVelocitySlow`, `fVelocityFast`), acceleration (`fAcceleration`), and deceleration (`fDeceleration`). The homing status for each axis is individually tracked (`bAxisXHomeOK`, `bAxisYHomeOK`, `bAxisZHomeOK`), and a combined status (`bHomeOK`) indicates if all axes are homed. The routine should also handle and prioritize errors across axes, updating `bError` and `sErrorString` accordingly. If `bExecute` is false, all homing statuses should be reset.
provide_code:
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_TripleAxisHoming
VAR_INPUT
	bExecute			:	BOOL;				//执行回零信号
	AxisX				:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;			//X轴引用
	AxisY				:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;			//Y轴引用
	AxisZ				:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;			//Z轴引用
	bAxisXRefSwitch		:	BOOL;				//X轴零点开关
	bAxisYRefSwitch		:	BOOL;				//Y轴零点开关
	bAxisZRefSwitch		:	BOOL;				//Z轴零点开关
	fVelocitySlow		:	REAL;				//慢速回零速度
	fVelocityFast		:	REAL;				//快速回零速度
	fAcceleration		:	REAL;				//加速度
	fDeceleration		:	REAL;				//减速度
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
	bHomeOK				:	BOOL;				//三轴都回零完成
	bAxisXHomeOK		:	BOOL;				//X轴回零完成
	bAxisYHomeOK		:	BOOL;				//Y轴回零完成
	bAxisZHomeOK		:	BOOL;				//Z轴回零完成
	bBusy				:	BOOL;				//回零进行中
	bError				:	BOOL;				//错误标志
	sErrorString		:	STRING;				//错误信息字符串
END_VAR
requirement_cn: 该代码应实现一个用于数控机床的三轴回零例程，使用提供的输入和输出。它应根据执行信号`bExecute`处理X轴、Y轴和Z轴的回零过程。每个轴都有一个参考开关（`bAxisXRefSwitch`、`bAxisYRefSwitch`、`bAxisZRefSwitch`）并使用慢速和快速速度（`fVelocitySlow`、`fVelocityFast`）、加速度（`fAcceleration`）和减速度（`fDeceleration`）的参数。每个轴的回零状态分别跟踪（`bAxisXHomeOK`、`bAxisYHomeOK`、`bAxisZHomeOK`），一个组合状态（`bHomeOK`）表示所有轴都已回零。该例程还应处理并优先处理各轴的错误，相应地更新`bError`和`sErrorString`。如果`bExecute`为假，则应重置所有回零状态。
